You can see a fridge. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? The fridge contains a block of cheese. You see an oven. You smell a wretched smell, and follow it to a table. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. You think about smashing the table to bits, throwing the bits into a pit, etc, until you get bored and decide to move on. You can make out a counter. On the counter you make out a red apple, a cookbook and a knife. Wow! Just like in the movies! You can make out a stove. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about a stove? But the thing hasn't got anything on it.

There is a closed plain door leading east. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is not blocked by one.

There is a carrot, a red hot pepper, a raw yellow potato and a banana on the floor.
